title: When Agents Get It Wrong
youtube_title: When Agents Get It Wrong: War Stories and a Diagnostic Playbook | The Agentic Crew, Ch. 16
description: A one-line fix that becomes thirty-two changed files, a library that doesn't exist, an infinite loop, a sleep that turned the tests green, and a ticket written by a stranger. In every case the agent did exactly what it was built to do. These are workflow bugs, and the fix is structure.
